population: Uhlitz author CNA tumor epithelial; prior conflict donor excluded
split: Within each donor, among raw LYPLA1 count > 0 cells: high if log1p(CP10K) > donor median, low otherwise; no arbitrary tie breaking
zeros: Excluded from both groups; question is high vs low among detected cells
unit: donor paired pseudobulk counts; not independent cells
differential: edgeR TMM filterByExpr(design) glmQLFit robust TRUE; design ~patient+group; high versus low
sensitivity: Same genes; design ~patient+log(mean total UMI per cell)+group if full rank; not used to choose primary result
gene_family: All 11058 tested genes retained; no new BH; prior Q values archived only
pathways: Reactome current human GMT; archive hash recorded, exact gene-symbol intersection
ORA: One-sided hypergeometric; actual tested-gene background; nominal P<0.05, no FDR threshold
GSEA: Reuse prior NES, raw P and leadingEdge; nominal P<0.05; no new permutations
interpretation: Exploratory coexpression programs; not causal regulation, activity, or independent validation; depth/composition and subtype confounding retained
user_change: User explicitly requested no FDR; nominal P and requested effect threshold
